privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains what data MitraMatika stores, where that data is sent and how to delete your account.
privacy.storedAccount: Account: your name, email address, school name if you give one, and your password as a hash (the password itself is never stored). If you sign in with Google, we receive your name and email address from Google. An account that the owner has not approved is still kept (name, email address and school name if given) until you delete it; you can delete your account at any time from the waiting-for-approval page or from Settings.
privacy.storedContent: Your work: question requests, the generated questions, your review decisions and your question bank.
privacy.storedTechnical: Technical data: sign-in sessions together with the IP address and browser they were started from, your language choice, counters by IP address and by hashed email address that limit how often sign-in, sign-up and email requests can be made (they expire within a day), and an activity log that holds only your account ID, not your email or name.
privacy.aiTitle: AI services and the data they get
privacy.aiGroq: Groq writes and checks the questions. Groq receives curriculum data (grade, topic, learning objectives, difficulty) and the text of the questions being written. Your name, email and school name are never sent.
privacy.aiGemini: Gemini by Google is only a fallback and only receives curriculum data that is public anyway.
privacy.emailService: Resend sends the confirmation and new password emails, so Resend receives your email address. Resend also sends an email to the MitraMatika owner whenever a new account with a verified email is waiting for approval; that email contains your name, your email address and your school name if you gave one.
privacy.students: MitraMatika does not collect student data. Do not write student names or other personal student data in the app; such data must never be sent to any AI service.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account at any time in Settings, under Account. Your account, your sessions, your questions and the rest of your work are deleted with it. What remains: a record that an account was deleted, which holds no name or email, only a one-way scrambled form of the account ID; earlier activity and error records, with your account ID removed; and the weekly database backups, which keep a copy of your data for up to 8 weeks until they are deleted. Resend keeps its own log of the emails it sent you.

solve.title: Solve a problem
solve.description: Type a problem or take a photo of it. The steps and the final answer are checked automatically where possible.

how.input: Type the problem with a formula preview, or take a photo of it.

how.another: Ask for another method when you need one. Every solve counts toward the daily limit.
